subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 8 4 6 4 6 1 9 6 7 2 2 2 2 1 5 5 1 6 6 7 2 5 5 (Right)

How many such odd digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd digit and also immediately followed by an even digit?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 8 4 6 4 6 1 9 6 7 2 2 2 2 1 5 5 1 6 6 7 2 5 5 (Right)

Now,

Odd digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd digit and also immediately followed by an even digit.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Odd — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6480f09ece89a28b8a196e54536e12dcbf16de323929dac16c7c2bee9b0dcc89.png] 

Thus, there are two odd digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd digit and also immediately followed by an even digit.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
